evidence.evidenceSnippet: For study and teaching at Heidelberg University, AI and language models such as ChatGPT or DeepL are generally allowed only within rules set by examiners or instructors, and the independent character of the student's work must be preserved.
Die Nutzung von KI und Sprachmodellen (LLMs) wie ChatGPT, DeepL oder anderen Werkzeugen ist im Studium und in der Lehre an der UHD grundsätzlich erlaubt.

description: Heidelberg University's on-premises open-source language-model platform.
howToObtain: Use YoKI from the University network or through the University VPN.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Heidelberg University's URZ makes YoKI available to students and employees. The University says its AI infrastructure is operated on premise on its own campus servers and that the service can only be used on the University network or via VPN.
Heidelberg University's computing centre says it develops and hosts its own AI infrastructure and provides the YoKI platform so university members can choose among several large language models.
Über die KI-Plattform YoKI können Universitätsmitglieder aus verschiedenen großen Sprachmodellen auswählen.
